verdict.rationale: A runtime probe shows Reclaim's hosted MCP endpoint enforces OAuth with a protected-resource flow advertising distinct scopes (read/write/mcp), which is evidence of some scoped credentialing for agent access, but there is no first-party documentation describing how a user actually issues/limits per-agent API keys or manages least-privilege scopes. Missing for 10: documented API-key/token issuance flow, explanation of what each scope grants, and any user-facing UI/docs for creating scoped credentials for agents.
